# Read whole PostgreSQL statement records, preserving each backend identity.
statements=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
 if re.match(r'^\d+ ',l):statements.append({'line':i,'pid':int(l.split(' ',1)[0]),'text':l})
 elif statements:statements[-1]['text']+='\n'+l

for pid in [70617,70647,70652]:
 st=[x for x in statements if x['pid']==pid];ss=[x for x in st if 'statement: SET search_path=pg_catalog; SELECT jsonb_build_object' in x['text']];ll=[x for x in st if 'statement: LISTEN ' in x['text']];assert len(ss)==1
 sql=ss[0]['text'].split('statement: SET search_path=pg_catalog; ',1)[1].strip();sql='\n'.join(l[1:] if l.startswith('\t') else l for l in sql.splitlines()).strip()
 assert sql==snap,(pid,'snapshot differs')
 assert (not ll) if pid==70647 else (len(ll)==1 and ss[0]['line']<ll[0]['line'])
 assert not any('pg_notify(' in x['text'] for x in st)
 proof[str(pid)]={'exact_shared_snapshot':True,'snapshot_line':ss[0]['line'],'LISTEN_lines':[x['line'] for x in ll],'publishing_SQL_on_this_backend':False}

refs=json.loads((o/'primary-references.json').read_text());u='https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/sql-createfunction.html';body=urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=7).read();refs['postgres_createfunction']={'url':u,'bytes':len(body),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()};(o/'primary-references.json').write_text(json.dumps(refs,indent=2)+'\n')
